decisive_items: compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery
response.rationale: The CT finding of left common iliac vein compression by the right common iliac artery is pathognomonic for May-Thurner syndrome, which directly explains the extensive DVT. R4 is a broader description of the immediate thrombotic event, while R1 captures the underlying anatomical cause.

rejected.why: Antiphospholipid antibody tests returned negative, contradicting the diagnosis.
Post-thrombotic syndrome is a chronic complication of DVT, not the acute presentation described here.
